name: Chief Ministergi Shotharabasingi Tengbang (CMST): Scholarship Of Students With Disabilities
benefit:
Class: 1st to 5th; Rate of Scholarship (per annum): ₹ 3,000/-.
Class: 6th to 8th; Rate of Scholarship (per annum): ₹ 4,000/-.
Class: 9th to 12th; Rate of Scholarship (per annum): ₹ 6,000/-.
Graduate & Above (including all Technical Courses): ₹ 8,000/-.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a Person with Disability (PwD). 1. The applicant should be a Student. 1. The applicant should be a domicile of the State of Manipur. 1. The applicant should be studying in Class 1st and above. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a school/college/university/institution recognized by the Govt. of Manipur. 1. The applicant should not be availing scholarship under any other similar scheme from any source.
